decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that the proposed vehicular crossover and hardstanding, because of its design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 56A Watermill Way and would not be detrimental to the amenity of the locality or the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. The application is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Devlopment Plan adopted December 2003.
description: Construction of a vehicular crossover to existing maisonnette.
